note: This record provides the research data and supporting documentation for the revised systematic review titled "Tactile and Physical Interaction Problems in In-Vehicle Infotainment Systems: A Systematic Literature Review". The current corpus comprises 342 eligible reports assessed using 34 operational codes across seven categories, yielding 11,628 report–code decisions: 3,635 positive, 7,677 negative and 316 unresolved. The materials are organised into eight editable Word volumes, each
title: Research Data and Reproducibility Materials for "Tactile and Physical Interaction Problems in In-Vehicle Infotainment Systems: A Systematic Literature Review"
